title: shellWindow() hands a spec a window whose shell has not booted
description: CI run 33373667728 failed fullscreen-titlebar.spec.js on master and blocked every push. tests/desktop/shellWindow.js resolves the shell window at domcontentloaded, but the renderer boots asynchronously after that: init.js awaits initPaths() and only then initShell(), whose step 0 is Hotkeys.init() — the F11 binding. Every other spec's first action is an auto-waiting locator, so it waits by accident; this one's first action is keyboard.press('F11'), which does not auto-wait, so the key lands in a renderer with no F11 handler, no IPC is ever sent, and the class never arrives. Reproduced locally 1-in-6 launches; the docs-only commit that triggered the red run is unrelated. Fix: shellWindow() waits for the shell to have booted before returning.
